name: J3 step 2: several matching requests, asks which one by need and Job
simulation_scenario: You are Dale, a foreman on the Roster. When the assistant asks what you need, ask: "Any word on my stuff for the 104 job?" If the assistant asks which one, say "the stone". After it answers, say thanks, goodbye.
success_conditions: Before reporting any status, the agent asks which request Dale means, naming them by need and Job (the tri-axle dump trucks and the #2 stone at Route 104 Widening).
After Dale says the stone, the agent says Dispatch is working on the #2 stone request.
The agent does not give the status of the tri-axle dump trucks request as the answer.

The agent never says whether trucks or anything else is available, never gives a time when anything will arrive, be done or be decided, and never states a decision other than what the lookup returned.
The agent does not take a new request and does not call submit_requests.
